title: Stage 2 preflight readiness gate
goal: Verify Stage 1 ready/pass status, prior workflow completion, validation artifacts, blocked routing scans, and operator-only decisions before any playbook work starts.

title: Playbook schema and validation scaffolding
goal: Create the agent playbook directory, manifest schema, validation script, and Stage 2 source-routing plan.

title: Service development and SQL generation playbooks
goal: Create playbooks for Altibase-backed service planning plus SQL, DDL, DCL, DML, schema, privilege, object, data type, property, view, and validation artifact generation.

title: Application connectivity playbooks
goal: Create source-backed playbooks for JDBC, ODBC, CLI, ACI, Precompiler, Java/Spring/Hibernate, connection configuration, compile/link/runtime checks, and diagnostics.

title: Administration and protected operations playbooks
goal: Create guarded playbooks for installation, startup/shutdown, properties, tablespaces, backup/recovery, archive logs, security-sensitive administration, and protected operations.

title: Replication, CDC, and HA playbooks
goal: Create guarded playbooks for replication topology, DDL, state checks, sync/conflict handling, CDC, Log Analyzer, and Replication Manager.

title: Tools, utilities, migration, and integration playbooks
goal: Create playbooks for iSQL, iLoader, utilities, dataCompJ, dump tools, altiComp, aexport, Migration Center, Adapter for Oracle, DB Link, Hadoop, Kubernetes/AKU, Spatial, NiFi, and Tableau.

title: Troubleshooting and performance playbooks
goal: Create playbooks for exact error handling, log/symptom triage, monitoring, dictionary/performance views, tuning checks, escalation points, and safe next checks.

title: AID, version, release, and patch routing playbooks
goal: Create playbook routing guidance for AID-derived content, 7.1/7.3/8.1 boundaries, release-note tokens, patch-specific claims, accepted limitations, and source recheck guardrails.

title: Coding-agent and GPT instruction notes
goal: Create coding-agent and GPT service-development instruction notes that define source routing, missing-input prompts, generated-artifact structure, and forbidden generic assumptions.

title: Scenario tests and judge rubric
goal: Create representative GPT and coding-agent scenario tests plus the judge rubric for required source IDs, exact tokens, forbidden assumptions, missing inputs, artifacts, validations, stop conditions, and pass thresholds.

title: Playbook crosswalks and validation report
goal: Validate playbook source-ID and baseline coverage, generate source-to-playbook crosswalks, update the playbook gap register, and write the playbook validation report.

title: Stage 2 readiness review
goal: Review all Stage 2 outputs, rerun validation, preserve guardrails, and write a ready/pass or not-ready Stage 2 readiness report.
